name: all countries preserve presence evidence
input: Which countries have I been to?
expectedOutput: A country list grounded in the returned places and evidence, with layovers distinguished from stops, visits, and residences.

name: country count explains inclusion rule
input: How many countries have I visited?
expectedOutput: The assistant gives a country count and states the inclusion rule. Either 9 (every country with any recorded stop, layover, visit, or residence evidence) or a narrower count that names which countries it left out and why (for example Ireland as residence-only, the UAE as layover-only) is correct. A bare number with no rule is wrong.

name: Iceland layover is not described as a destination stop
input: Have I ever been to Iceland, and what place/evidence is recorded?
expectedOutput: The assistant reports Iceland with Reykjavik (KEF airport) on 2018-06-01 and labels that record a layover rather than a stay (a separate visit record on the same date is fine to mention).

name: lived countries use residence evidence
input: Which countries have I lived in?
expectedOutput: The assistant reports the United Kingdom and Ireland from Residence periods and does not treat visits or layovers alone as living there.

name: visited but never lived excludes residence countries
input: Which countries have I visited but never lived in?
expectedOutput: The assistant includes evidence-backed non-residence countries such as Iceland and France, and excludes the United Kingdom and Ireland because Residence evidence exists there. Other countries may also be included when their returned evidence qualifies; the answer should not imply Iceland and France are the only qualifying countries.

name: layovers require connecting-flight evidence
input: Where have I only had airport layovers?
expectedOutput: The assistant identifies Dubai as having only layover evidence. It excludes Reykjavik because a Visit is also recorded there, and does not label ordinary final-destination airports as layovers.

name: residence and trip evidence can overlap
input: Which countries have I both lived in and visited on a trip?
expectedOutput: The assistant identifies the United Kingdom as having both residence and Journey-stop evidence for London.

name: latest presence compares evidence dates
input: When was the last time I was in Sweden?
expectedOutput: The assistant returns the latest Stockholm visit, August 12, 2024, rather than the older visit.

name: repeat country evidence remains multiple occurrences
input: Which countries have I been to more than once?
expectedOutput: The assistant identifies Japan from two distinct Tokyo Journey stops and does not merge distinct Places based only on similar names.

name: country evidence is explainable
input: What countries have I been to, and how do you know?
expectedOutput: The assistant supports each country with named places and the corresponding stop, layover, visit, or residence evidence instead of referring to a method difference.
